claims: In texting and slang, SB most commonly means somebody or someone.
SB is an abbreviation for SB Nation, which is sports media.
Sb is the chemical symbol for antimony.
In baseball, SB is an abbreviation for stolen base.
On Tinder, SB can mean same-sex attracted or same-sex bi.
In finance, SB can refer to Safe Bulkers, Inc.
In Chinese internet slang, SB can be used as an insult (shǎbī)
